digest.component_or_area: raw git write static checker (check_raw_git_writes.py policy d37e)

propositions: R3 rule must fire when git-adapter mutation primitives (add, commit, commit_tree, read_tree, rm_cached, update_ref, write_tree) are called from outside the sanctioned seam files (git_adapter.py, _ref_lock.py, _ref_lock_push.py)

R3 must resolve git-adapter receiver bindings via import statements (from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter) and dynamic-loader patterns (_load with module-path string) to distinguish actual git-adapter calls from coincidental method names like set.add() or session.commit()
Existing unsanctioned composition sites (reconcile_helpers.py:226/246 and __main__.py:338-351) must each carry a durable reasoned # raw-git-ok marker explaining why they bypass the atomic transaction
R3 violations must be sanctionable via the existing # raw-git-ok: <reason> inline marker (line-level or function-level), reusing the established marker vocabulary without introducing a new allowlist
The gate must produce zero false positives across src/ and scripts/ on non-git-adapter .add()/.commit() calls and must not fire on read-only exports like commit_email or rev_parse
Implementation must include parametrized regression tests covering import bindings, dynamic-loader bindings, sanctioned entry files, marker semantics, and whole-tree clean state
